name: A-10 Thunderbolt II
summary: Straight-winged, heavily armored close-air-support jet built around a huge 30 mm cannon; being drawn down by the Air Force but still in service.

wings: Long straight low-mounted wing with slightly drooped tips
Main landing gear in pods under the wing leading edge, wheels partly exposed when retracted
Many underwing pylons for bombs, rockets and Maverick missiles
engines: Two large round turbofan pods mounted high on the rear fuselage
Engines set between the wing and tail, above the fuselage
fuselage: Long blunt nose with a cannon muzzle protruding beneath it
Usually dark two-tone grey with a painted false canopy underneath
tail: Twin vertical fins mounted at the tips of a straight horizontal tail (H-tail)
Tail shields the engine exhausts from the sides

tellTales: Two big round engine pods perched on the upper rear fuselage
Twin fins at the tips of a straight tailplane
Long straight wings with semi-exposed main wheels in pods

confusedWith.howToTell: The A-10 has straight wings, engine pods mounted above the rear fuselage and fins at the tailplane tips; the F-15 has swept wings, engines buried in the fuselage and fins on the body.
